newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms Norcen Energy ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms Norcen Energy ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Monday it reaffirmed its ratings on Norcen Energy Resources Ltd's debt with a stable outlook.
CBRS said it confirmed Norcen's senior debentures at A (low) and commercial paper at A-1 (low).
It said the maintenance of the ratings reflected Norcen's success in achieving goals to strengthen its balance sheet and operational effectiveness.

"The combination of a low-cost structure, sharply reduced debt levels and relatively strong product prices combined to provide a sharp boost to operating earnings (before gains on asset sales) and a much more flexible capital structure," CBRS said.
Norcen ended 1996 with its lowest debt levels of the decade and healthy cash reserve despite record exploration and development spending for the year, it said.
The Calgary-based oil and gas producer redeemed a C$149.9 million series B convertible debenture and repaid another C$229.9 million of long-term debt in addition to extending its maturity schedule.
In 1997, Norcen's capital spending was expected to be meet or beat last year's C$560 million and the budget was to be funded essentially from cash flow.
